parts.title: runs
parts.body: One row per request: what kind of run, its state, who submitted it, and when it was cancelled or withdrawn and by whom. Nothing is ever deleted.

parts.title: tasks
parts.body: One row per task: its run, the task it retries, its state, the work file and its digest, the result file, the launcher's job ID, instance type, release and timings.

parts.title: inference_runs
parts.body: What an inference run asked for: the configuration digest, current output versions, the frozen recording list, and how the selection was made.

parts.title: recording_outcomes
parts.body: One row per recording in a run: its state, why it was skipped, which task handled it, and any failure. A recording can hold only one active claim per configuration, which is how duplicate work is avoided.

parts.title: output_files
parts.body: Every output file a worker wrote, by run and recording: its kind, contract, URI and checksum.

parts.title: configurations
parts.body: A model plus its settings, identified by a digest. Two runs with the same digest asked for the same thing.

parts.title: presets
parts.body: Named configurations people can reuse, like a saved recipe.

parts.title: models
parts.body: Each registered model: its card, its pinned files, and the current version of its outputs.

parts.title: current_files · view
parts.body: For every recording and configuration, the output files that are current, and whether they are up to date. This is what tools like api-dock read.

parts.title: current_datasets · view
parts.body: One dataset per configuration that gathers its current results.
